text:
Predicates:
ProBasketballPlayer(x) ::: x is a professional basketball player.
American(x) ::: x is an American national.
CanDoJumpShot(x) ::: x can do jump shots.
LeapsStraight(x) ::: x leaps straight into the air.
ActivateLegMuscles(x) ::: x activates their leg muscles.
Yuri ::: the individual Yuri.
Premises:
∃x (ProBasketballPlayer(x) ∧ ¬American(x)) ::: Some professional basketball players are not American nationals.
∀x (ProBasketballPlayer(x) → CanDoJumpShot(x)) ::: All professional basketball players can do jump shots.
∀x (CanDoJumpShot(x) → LeapsStraight(x)) ::: If someone can do jump shots, they leap straight into the air.
∀x (LeapsStraight(x) → ActivateLegMuscles(x)) ::: If someone leaps straight into the air, they activate their leg muscles.
¬ActivateLegMuscles(Yuri) ::: Yuri does not activate his leg muscles.
Conclusion:
¬(ProBasketballPlayer(Yuri) ∧ American(Yuri)) ::: Yuri is not an American professional basketball player.
